Construct a region from already computed sufficient statistics

Source: R/region.R
emax_region_from_summary.Rd

Uses the same assumptions and calibrations as [emax_region()]. The variance must be the pooled within-dose variance with `sum(counts) - length(x)` degrees of freedom, not a standard error, model residual variance, or population variance. Counts are positive integers. Different replication counts at different doses are supported.

Usage

emax_region_from_summary(
  x,
  counts,
  means,
  pooled_variance,
  D = max(x),
  alpha = 0.05,
  calibration = c("contrast", "mean")
)

Arguments

x

Nonempty numeric vector of observed doses.

counts

Replication counts, one per ordered distinct dose.

means

Dose-specific sample means, in the same order as `x`.

pooled_variance

Positive finite pooled within-dose variance.

D

Positive upper dose endpoint. Defaults to the maximum supplied dose.

alpha

Error probability strictly between zero and one.

calibration

Either `"contrast"` (primary method) or `"mean"` (full mean-region benchmark).

Value

An `emax_region` object.
